sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's underlying form remains strong with seven wins from their last six games before that defeat. They then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00), continuing a busy period that includes a midweek fixture.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on 3 October in a fixture between mid-table sides, before travelling to Wednesfield Community on 10 October. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth are at home to Eccleshall on the opening Saturday. Wolverhampton Casuals, also in contention, visit Wednesfield Community on 3 October. Foley Meir host Bilston Town (5th place, in strong form) on the opening weekend. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home on 3 October before travelling to face Bilston on 10 October, while fellow strugglers Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Sandbach on 10 October after hosting Telford Town (bottom half) on 3 October. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town on 3 October and host Telford Town on 10 October. Brereton Social (currently 14th) play Widnes Town at home on 3 October, then host Wednesfield Community in a midweek clash on 7 October before visiting Allscott Heath on 10 October. Shawbury United travel to Brereton on 3 October before facing Alsager Town at home on 10 October. Sandbach's 10 October opposition Cheadle Heath Nomads also host Sandbach on that date. Widnes Town, second from bottom, visit Brereton on 3 October and Market Drayton Town on 10 October. Market Drayton face New Mills at home on 3 October before hosting Widnes on 10 October. Barnton host Shawbury on 3 October before visiting Barnton on 10 October. Alsager Town face Sandbach away on 3 October then host Shawbury United on 10 October.
